name: Danganronpa O - Sea of Despair
source:
After the immense success of the original Hope's Peak Academy building, several more official schools were established. In celebration of the expansion within the ultimate generation, a special cruise trip was arranged for all ultimate students. Norika Kobayashi, the ultimate [redacted], is attending this trip with her two best friends! It's time to meet other ultimates and get out of her shell a little. What could possibly go wrong?

[From [url=https://obsidian-eyes.itch.io/danganronpa-o-sea-of-despair]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在最初的希望峰学院建设取得巨大成功后，又建立了几所官方学校。为了庆祝终极一代的扩展，我们为所有终极学生安排了一次特别的游轮之旅。终极[redacted]小林纪香与她的两个好朋友一起参加这次旅行！是时候迎接其他终极挑战并稍微摆脱她的外壳了。可能会出现什么问题？

[来自[url=https://obsidian-eyes.itch.io/danganronpa-o-sea-of-despair]itch.io[/url]]
